messages:
Harper Lee: Quick Q — my last day will be Fri 2024-08-16. Need confirmation on COBRA eligibility window and effective end date for benefits, final paycheck timing, and instructions for returning my MacBook. Also want to set up an exit interview. cc @People Ops
People Ops: Thanks Harper — we can help with all of that. Quick bullets:
• COBRA: enrollment window opens on separation; benefits admin emails the COBRA packet within 7 business days. Active company coverage will end on your termination date (2024-08-16). If you enroll, COBRA coverage is retroactive to the day after termination.
• Final pay: payroll will include final wages + accrued PTO in the next regular payroll cycle (expected 2024-08-30). If you have outstanding expenses, please submit receipts by EOD Wed 2024-08-14.
• Exit interview: we can schedule next week — give a couple of options that work for you.
Harper Lee: Thanks. I'd like to keep health coverage through September if COBRA works that way. Also who handles 401(k) rollover paperwork?
PayrollBot: Harper — final pay includes accrued PTO per policy. 401(k) vendor (Brightpath) will send rollover packet and login instructions within ~10 calendar days of termination.
Samir Patel: Can someone confirm laptop return logistics? I can bring it to HQ drop-off if that helps.
IT-Bot: Asset return steps: follow self-service portal: https://redwood-internal/it/returns — choose "Device Return via Manager" if Samir will drop it. Provide asset tag and power down the device before handing off. Example info to include: `asset_tag: RBW-MB-4232`, `serial: C02X1234JGHF`. If mailing, use the pre-paid label generated by the portal and email it-help@redwood.com with tracking. Note: we schedule account deprovision at 6:00pm PST on the termination date (2024-08-16) unless a manual exception is requested.
Harper Lee: Asset tag is RBW-MB-4232. I'll do manager drop-off. Also need access token revocation — how long until 3rd-party tokens are cut?
IT-Bot: SSO accounts are disabled within 24 hours of termination. Personal service tokens (GitHub PATs, AWS keys) are not auto-rotated — owners must rotate or revoke before leaving. If there are service accounts or long-lived keys to hand off, list them here or DM IT and we'll coordinate a safe rotation window.
Harper Lee: OK — I'll DM a short list tonight. For the exit interview, Tue or Thu next week 10–11am PT work for me.
People Ops: Booked: Exit interview with Rina (People Ops) on Thu 2024-08-22 10:00–10:30 PT. Calendar invite and short questionnaire sent. Thanks everyone :pray:
Samir Patel: :thumbsup: I'll take the device to HQ on 2024-08-17 and drop it in the IT dropbox. Harper — thank you for coordinating and happy to help with the handoff.
People Ops: Closing checklist for Harper: 
• COBRA packet will be emailed within 7 business days
• Final paycheck targeted 2024-08-30
• IT deprovision scheduled for 2024-08-16 18:00 PST (exceptions require IT ticket)
• Exit interview scheduled 2024-08-22 10:00 PT
Harper Lee: Appreciate it — I'll submit expenses tonight and send the token list.
